description: This file defines a static class ResponsePool that manages object pooling for Response<T> objects, including methods to get and return pooled objects, and an internal generic class TypedPool<T> holding the pool instance.

classes.name: ResponsePool
classes.description: A static class providing pooling operations for Response<T> objects.

classes.name: TypedPool<T>
classes.description: A private static generic class holding a pool of Response<T> objects.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a Response<T> object from the pool.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Returns a Response<T> object to the pool.
